notablePrerequisites: Lotus Field does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mishra's Groundbreaker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Lotus Field to become a 3/3 artifact creature that's still a land.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 2.
